note: Synthetic example bibles for Lantern Quay, a three-scene story written for the story-editor test suite and public examples. Original content, free to reuse.

wren.label: Wren Calloway — apprentice chartmaker
wren.role: Nineteen, apprentice to the harbour's chartmaker. Notices what doesn't fit and acts on it before she has finished being afraid.
wren.channel: Spatial and auditory. She reads the world as a chart: what sits too low in the water, what sounds wrong, where the lines don't meet.
wren.bias_lens: Trusts what she has seen and heard over what she has been told; distrusts anything presented too smoothly.
voice_rules: Speaks plainly and briefly, often in observations rather than opinions.
Dry humour when nervous; never cruel.
forbidden_phrasings: Never speaks in nautical jargon she hasn't earned; she is a chartmaker, not a sailor.

ilse.label: Ilse Calloway — harbour clerk
ilse.role: Wren's older sister, clerk of the harbour ledger. Careful, exact, and more afraid of being wrong than of being in danger.
ilse.channel: Numbers and procedure. Weights, counts, seals, signatures.
ilse.bias_lens: Believes the ledger until the ledger contradicts itself; then believes nothing until she has checked it twice.
voice_rules: Precise, procedural speech; states the facts before the conclusion.
Calls her sister by name when she is worried.
forbidden_phrasings: Never guesses aloud; she says 'the ledger says' or 'I don't know yet'.

varga.label: Captain Amos Varga — master of the Gull's Due
varga.role: Master of the brig Gull's Due. Charming, practical, and smuggling stolen Admiralty survey charts of the reef passages.
varga.channel: People as prices: he reads what someone wants and offers it.
varga.bias_lens: Everyone can be bought; the only question is the currency.
voice_rules: Warm, easy, a little theatrical; makes threats sound like advice.
forbidden_phrasings: Never confesses outright; he only implies.
